description: A SvelteKit app with the path router: nested layouts (items), a route group ((account)), a dynamic parameter with a matcher ([id=integer]), universal loads with parent() that run again only when what they read changed (console lines), link clicks (absolute and relative hrefs), goto (with replaceState, with a query, to a fragment that scrolls and becomes the focus starting point), beforeNavigate cancelling links and back, afterNavigate, back and forward, error() in a load rendering the nearest +error.svelte, redirect() in a load, kept layout and page instances, titles and the announcer
